title.heading: SCOPE OF RULES; FORM OF ACTION

courtRule.heading: Scope and Purpose
courtRule.content: These rules govern the procedure in all civil actions and proceedings in the United States district courts.

courtRule.heading: Review of Social Security Decisions Under 42 U.S.C. § 405(g)
courtRule.content: These rules govern an action under 42 U.S.C. § 405(g).

section.heading: Short title
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Interstate Agreement on Detainers Act”.

section.heading: Definitions
section.content: For the purposes of this Act, “classified information” means any information or material that has been determined to require protection.
